title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft Campus Solutions → Student
description: Maps Oracle PeopleSoft Campus Solutions tables to the HELIX Student resource.

source_tables.description: Person biographical data. Birth date, gender.
Person names. Supports name history and types.
Student career term. Academic status, load, GPA per career per term.
Student residency status for tuition purposes.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. EmplID is PeopleSoft's universal person key.
attribute_mappings.notes: EmplID is used across all PeopleSoft modules (HCM, CS, Financials). A single person has one EmplID.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. Use current effective-dated row (max EFFDT where EFFDT <= SYSDATE, NAME_TYPE = 'PRI').
Direct map. Use current primary name record.
Use preferred name row if it exists; null otherwise.
Map PeopleSoft codes: 'M'→'male', 'F'→'female', 'U'→'unknown'. Newer versions may have PS_GENDER_IDENTITY for expanded options.
Map PeopleSoft academic program status to HELIX: 'AC'→'enrolled', 'LA'→'leave_of_absence', 'DC'→'withdrawn', 'CM'→'graduated'. Use most recent career term row.
attribute_mappings.notes: PeopleSoft tracks status at the career+program level. A student can have multiple careers (UGRD, GRAD). Consider the primary or most recent.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map PeopleSoft residency codes to HELIX: 'RES'→'in_state', 'NRES'→'out_of_state', 'INTL'→'international'. Institution-specific codes in RESIDENCY table.
attribute_mappings.notes: Use effective-dated row for the relevant term.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map PeopleSoft country code to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. PeopleSoft uses 3-char codes (e.g., 'USA'→'US').

attribute_mappings.notes: PeopleSoft does not have a standard first-gen field in all versions. Often added as a custom field.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Use the most recent timestamp across source tables
